purpose: Reviewer instructions, not player copy or sign-off.
rules: Every topic file is an unsigned review dossier. entry alone uses the existing register schema; all other keys are out-of-world annotations. Nothing is copied to a live register.
Existing entries are carried from pinned 5c1e8ed; existing refused signatures, windows and holds are preserved. New entry status is a candidate for review, not approval.

Sources are dossier-local references, not new PROVENANCE ids. The cited research was read; this run does not claim a new primary-source inspection. Adopt primary rows and their scoped locators before live use.

A7 requires an independent reviewer, current question versions and a hash over the final content, cited rows and strings. No gateReview/signature field is written here. The reviewer signs only after approved placement and source adoption.
A8 ship blockers remain: R2 pay, R3 Dakota, R4 prisoners, R6 guerrillas, whole-topic camp sources; new record candidates cannot be interpreted as a release clearance.
B5/0060: every decision and inaction has unconditional locked costs on the decider’s side. No detection/chance/cancellation escape. Cost size, active owners and proponents require later evidence.

D5/E7: atrocities are never options; dependency taint follows effects/causes across tags. No atrocity-derived positive acting-side term, whoever appointed the commander. 0074 restrictive options only, letting-stand only watched inaction; Dakota remains R3’s separate question.

D6: watched options and atrocity-dependent inaction require the actual seeded sweep after mechanics exist. More than one-quarter best-choice seeds flags review; these draft probes are no sweep clearance.

Protected people are agents, never pools, counted/spent/assigned by a verb, target, goal, transfer, initiative or setup. Protected census inputs are read-only to derivations; existing regions-owned arrival state remains under 0046, not a new stock.
Agency reasons are typed candidates; each nonzero future term must explain people’s choices and have an owner/graph review. Reasons do not authorize a field or quantitative effect.

Setting vocabulary stays in the pack. Existing class flags are referenced, not changed. Native-nation atrocity conduct must additionally receive a suitable atrocity tag/class before any live authoring.
No player text is delivered except clearly labeled wording examples. No slogans, clipped triads, aphorisms, all-caps eyebrow labels, hindsight defaults or praise/scolding.

Names of people, acts, dates, estimates and motives require the exact cited source. Publication, report, event, receipt and knowledge dates differ. B2 requires State causes, not a fixed date alone, absent an accepted railroad.

Disputed figures retain source/date/category. Comparable estimates may be ranges; incompatible categories are separate statements, not manufactured intervals. No rates from stocks and cumulative deaths.

Narrator prefers enslaved people and enslaver. Contraband as a noun for people, slurs and Lost Cause formulations are confined to short, attributed, cited quotations with reviewer note. No new quotation exemption is granted.

Keep all live forbidden, triggers, anachronisms, proper-noun allowlists and source policy. Draft trigger candidates request review; ordinary proper names must not become false positive topic assignments.
No more than a short contextual excerpt if a future quotation is adopted. Earlier quotation/voice rules in 0074 remain, including no generated voice or value reason from founding quotations.
The final January proclamation, December Dakota execution review, December capture proclamation, 1863 riots/commutation/impressment and 1864 massacres stay outside the August 1861–November 1862 core.
